test_setitem_none_nan: test setting None and np.nan values into a datetime64 Series to verify they become NaT
test_setitem_with_tz: test setting scalar and vector Timestamp values into a datetime64tz Series with various timezones
test_setitem_boolean_mask: test setting values into a Series using boolean mask indexers with alignment and type promotion
test_setitem_with_expansion: test setting values into an empty Series or with new keys to verify index expansion behavior
test_setitem_categorical: test setting categorical values into a Series with Categorical dtype to verify category preservation
test_setitem_casting_equivalents: test that various indexing methods (iloc, loc, at, iat, slices, masks) produce equivalent setitem results
test_setitem_readonly_backing_data: test that setting values into a Series with read-only numpy backing data raises ValueError
test_setitem_coercion_int8: test setting values into an int8 Series to verify dtype coercion and overflow behavior
test_setitem_coercion_datetime64tz: test setting Timestamp values with matching or mismatched timezones into a datetime64tz Series
test_setitem_coercion_bool: test setting various types into a bool Series to verify casting to object or rejection
